metadata.description:
Write-ahead preregistered benchmark (OSIRIS-BT2T-001-FEZ, Card A; independent gate G1 signed off prior to submission) of exact non-abelian group inversion g -> g^-1 in the 24-element binary tetrahedral group 2T = Q_8 |x Z_3 embedded in a 5-qubit register (frozen encoding bt2t-enc-1) on a five-transmon heavy-hex T-junction [21, 22, 23, 16, 24] of the 156-qubit IBM Heron r2 processor ibm_fez (job dc2ee3uq4uuc73a56o6g; HARDWARE_ATTESTED, 288 ISA circuits, 27,648 equal-shot physical measurements across 3 interleaved randomized blocks, 11 s QPU, N_windows = 1).

  • Coset-parity Boolean factoring over 2T = Q_8 |x Z_3 compresses heavy-hex CZ count 10.04x from 723 CZ (1,560 sqrt(X), unitary depth 2,073) in the generic 11-transposition reference to 72 CZ (151 sqrt(X), unitary depth 218) for the identical 32x32 permutation unitary, and compresses local pytket H2-native compilation from 400 to 47 ZZPhase gates (8.51x).
  • Uniform valid-24 raw inversion accuracy rises from 0.0661 +/- 0.0030 to 0.5337 +/- 0.0059 (0.6104 readout-mitigated, cond(M_32) = 1.4524), yielding Delta P_valid24 = +0.4676 (paired block t = 73.23, one-sided p = 9.32e-5; 24/24 elementwise wins, Wilcoxon p = 1.19e-7; H1 = SUPPORTED) and 32/32 exact modal majority-vote recovery.
  • Unused-codeword fixed-point preservation rises by +0.4818 (0.5595 vs 0.0777) while valid-to-unused subspace leakage drops to 0.0940 < 0.15 below the 0.25 uniform random baseline (H2 = SUPPORTED).
  • The interleaved 0-CZ SPAM control achieves 0.9076 ≥ 0.90 on unused-8 but 0.8643 < 0.90 on valid-24, honestly refuting H3 (REFUTED) and isolating an unflagged 14.91x live readout staleness excursion on leaf transmon q24 (0.33% published vs 4.92% live) and a 2.70x excursion on q21 (2.34% vs 6.33%).
metadata.title: Exact Binary Tetrahedral Group Inversion on a 5-Qubit Heavy-Hex Superconducting Register: Coset-Parity Synthesis Compression and Unflagged Readout Staleness (OSIRIS-BT2T-001-FEZ)

metadata.description:
Unified synthesis of 7 preregistered hardware campaigns (42 IBM Quantum jobs, 1,062 PUBs, 2,174,976 physical circuit shots, 673 s QPU) across all three 156-qubit IBM Heron r2 processors (ibm_marrakesh, ibm_fez, and ibm_kingston).

  • In 40-qubit compilation benchmarks at fixed 39-CZ depth 66 (TMAP-02–TMAP-05), calibration-ranked vs median path fidelity reversed from +10.54 pp to −4.29 pp four days later due to an unflagged q46 readout excursion (35.0% actual vs 1.1% published), and repeating a pre-job readout-probe selector 82–85 minutes apart flipped the probe-vs-calibration sign on all three processors while tensored readout mitigation restored calibration-path superiority on all three.
  • Longitudinal monitoring and isolation experiments (RO-06 and RO-07, 27 jobs, 516,096 shots) show hidden faults (>15% actual vs <3% listed) are transient (6 of 6 recovered below 5%), persist across 15-minute rounds at 87.4% (Fisher OR 1,095), and exhibit ≤1.16 pp multiplexing shift (≤1.61 pp neighbor state-flip shift), tracing reversals to calibration snapshots static up to 16.0 h rather than readout crosstalk.
  • Multiplexed DD spectroscopy across 10 couplers ≥5 hops apart (CN-01, 499,712 shots) gave null mechanistic contrasts (C_DFS = +0.43 pp, p_Holm = 0.47) while white-noise-only GLS falsely favored a non-local OU bath by Delta-BIC = 10,263 before failing its preregistered 6-coupler held-out gate (p = 0.82); a 550-replicate synthetic audit proves white-noise nulls misclassify 100% of local 1/f dephasing whereas local colored-noise nulls cut false non-local selection to 0%.
metadata.title: Calibration Staleness, Transient Readout Telegraphing, and Colored-Noise False Positives Across Three 156-Qubit Superconducting Quantum Processors

metadata.description:
Algebraic proofs and reproducible SIMULATED benchmarks (provider_job_id: null) calibrated to the 98-qubit Quantinuum Helios-1 all-to-all QCCD architecture across non-abelian quantum LDPC coding and pre-submission peaked-circuit classical-hardness gating.

  • Proves via group-inversion anti-automorphism and Frobenius / Wedderburn–Artin duality that unquotiented regular two-block group-algebra (2BGA) CSS codes over F_2[G] satisfy rank(H_X) = rank(H_Z) identically for every finite group G, forcing even logical dimension k (0 violations across 6,480 subset pairs over 11 non-abelian groups).
  • Breaking left-right regularity via subgroup-quotient cosets (including D_9/Z_2 with n = 21, k = 3) or symplectic minimum-weight gauge pinning yields 16 odd-k (k in {1, 3, 5}, d ≥ 4) non-abelian CSS codes—including exact D_9 [[36,3,6]], C_7 x| C_3 [[42,3,6]], and ISD-witnessed C_19 x| C_3 [[114,3,12]] (kd^2/n = 3.7895)—benchmarked under log-domain Sum-Product BP+OSD-CS decoding.
  • Formulates the fail-closed ADV-1 pre-gate requiring candidate peaked circuits to defeat bounded-chi MPS (chi ≤ 128), truncated Pauli-path (w_max ≤ 4), and causal light-cone (≤ 20 qubits) attacks; appending the 15-CX involution M_6 = J_6 - I_6 (mod 2) eliminates weight-four Pauli leakage and yields 24-qubit and 30-qubit chorded circuits surviving all three classical attacks (predicted Helios-1 peaks 0.3908 and 0.3508).
metadata.title: Left-Right Rank Duality in Non-Abelian Two-Block Group-Algebra Quantum LDPC Codes and a Three-Attack Classical-Hardness Pre-Gate for Looped Non-Mirror Peaked Circuits

metadata.description:
Preregistered 27-qubit stability benchmark on the IBM Heron r2 processor ibm_fez (protocol OSIRIS-WP2-27Q-FEZ, job dc1tqvinj2vs73dfrts0; 48 ISA circuits, 98,304 raw shots, 28 s QPU, constant 52-CZ / 378-SX heavy-hex tree with zero routing SWAPs) paired with multi-width SIMULATED hypercube benchmarks up to 96 qubits and hardware re-scoring of archived Heron r2 datasets.

  • Resolves both the refuted legacy Eq. (7) marginal-product self-cost artifact (0.50918 at Q = 27) and the Weed–Bach O(S^{-1/Q}) finite-shot sparsity artifact of raw plug-in Kantorovich optimal transport via exact multivariate-hypergeometric sample-size-matched two-by-two split-sample Kantorovich and Sinkhorn (epsilon = 0.05) U-statistics.
  • Across theta in {2.118, 2.618, 3.118} rad on ibm_fez, matched split-sample Sinkhorn collapses inter-block A/A drift to ≤ 0.000076 (< 0.005 threshold, H1 supported), confirms no special stability advantage at the golden-ratio angle theta* = 2.618 rad (H2 supported), and detects controlled coherent perturbations Delta-theta = 0.45 rad monotonically at 13.76 sigma (H3 supported).
  • On SIMULATED Uniform({0,1}^96), raw plug-in LP suffers a +855.48 sigma false-drift artifact whereas matched split-sample Sinkhorn yields z = -0.34 sigma; archived ibm_marrakesh (job dau0q3qhcrkc73durtgg) and 49-bit OSIRIS-QEC-001 (job dbtl2vb2kf8s73c9a0d0) counts corroborate clean separation of hardware drift from sampling sparsity.
metadata.title: Eliminating Finite-Shot Hypercube Sparsity Bias in 27-Qubit Quantum Processor Stability Benchmarks via Split-Sample-Debiased Optimal Transport

metadata.description:
Hardware-attested Hayden–Preskill conditional recovery experiment on a seven-transmon heavy-hex T-junction of the 156-qubit IBM Heron r2 processor ibm_fez (jobs dc1tqaanj2vs73dfrt40 and dc23ouqnj2vs73dg3bog; 184,320 total shots, 54 s QPU) measuring the exact 16-operator remnant Kraus trajectory for a continuous non-Clifford three-qubit scrambler U(theta).

  • A universal two-sqrt(X) Euler synthesis locks an identical 28-CZ, 126-SX native gate skeleton with zero routing SWAPs across every angle theta, reducing continuous scrambling sweeps to pure virtual-Z frame updates.
  • Six-state conditional recovery rises monotonically from F_6(0 | Phi+) = 0.4964 (P_Phi+ = 0.8913) through peak stabilizer magic theta = pi/4 (F_6 = 0.5998, P_Phi+ = 0.5198) to F_6(pi/2 | Phi+) = 0.8568 +/- 0.0043 raw (0.8771 readout-mitigated, P_Phi+ = 0.2454), exceeding theta = 0 by +0.3602 (t = 62.39, p = 4.54e-6).
  • Confirmatory job dc23ouqnj2vs73dg3bog executes all four non-trivial mid-scrambler Pauli-Z twirls inside every randomized block, separating coherent scrambling from dephasing on the identical 28-CZ pulse schedule by +0.1481 +/- 0.0101 (t = 14.61) at 3pi/8 and +0.2283 +/- 0.0149 (t = 15.28, p_Holm = 6.09e-4) at pi/2.
  • Includes an offline-compiled [[4,2,2]] codespace companion bundle staged for Quantinuum H2-1 (2,330 HQC).
metadata.title: Continuous-Angle Non-Clifford Hayden-Preskill Scrambling Trajectory and Stratified Decoherence Discrimination on a 156-Qubit Superconducting Processor (OSIRIS-XTOP-006)
